title: Read the number of venue vacancies
goal: Use dot notation to read object properties, distinguishing between recorded number 0 and missing properties.
summary: Venue reservation data sometimes does not provide the number of vacancies. A null count of 0 means full, a missing field means it is currently unknown.
tasks: completes readFreeSeats(room) and reads the freeSeats attribute of the venue object.
provides freeSeats, this number is returned directly, including 0. Returns null if not provided.

example.note: The attribute name is written after the period. Reads undefined when the attribute is missing. The recorded 0 is still a valid number.

hint: Using || to provide a default value will also replace the number 0. You can first determine whether freeSeats is equal to undefined.
